description: This file contains CMake functions and macros for configuring and installing header-only libraries and packages. It defines functions to generate configuration files, manage dependencies, and set installation paths specifically for CMake projects.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library target, generating necessary CMake configuration files and setting up target properties and dependencies.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates a package configuration file, typically a pkg-config file, for header-only libraries, including setting compilation options, include directories, and linking information.
